candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarification of current ocular status, distinguishing eyelid/adnexal scarring from any intraocular inflammation
candidate_requirements.rationale: Eyelid scarring and ocular surface complications are described, but intraocular involvement is not characterised; this distinction materially changes the differential and urgency of specialist input.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Ophthalmology (ocular inflammation service) reassessment with slit-lamp examination; documented absence of intraocular inflammation.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before any further immunosuppressive or diagnostic decision; proposed as an immediate written request.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Confirmation that no active infection (including recurrent C. difficile or other opportunistic infection) is present before any future immunosuppression
candidate_requirements.rationale: Prior severe C. difficile colitis, bowel perforation and resections make active infection the key safety contraindication to immunomodulation.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Infectious diseases review with current stool/other testing as clinically indicated.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before any immunosuppressive decision; proposed as an immediate written request.
